name: pi-chassis
description: A workbench for pi: an interface, git workflows and a widget platform for everyday engineering. Sidebar and home screen, Build/Plan modes, ctrl+x leader keys and a ctrl+p palette, a git diff view, git commands that draft commit messages and pull requests,
